MnO-IVTAN-1435.source: Lyutsareva, Bergman, and Gusarov, IVTAN Table 1435; the crystal Cp fit uses Shapiro et al. heat-capacity measurements and Southard and Shomate enthalpy increments.

MnSiO3-Robie-1995.source: Robie, Huebner, and Hemingway (1995), Heat capacities and thermodynamic properties of braunite and rhodonite, American Mineralogist 80, 560-575.
MnSiO3-Robie-1995.thermal_function: Cp = 99.04 + 0.01915*T - 3.041e6/T^2 + 274.5/sqrt(T) J mol^-1 K^-1; integrated from 298.15 K, with the source fit extended from 1500 K to the 1559-1564 K transition interval.

Mn2SiO4-Robie-1982.source: Robie et al. (1982), Entropies of Mg2SiO4, Mn2SiO4, and Co2SiO4, American Mineralogist 67, 470-482; primary solution-calorimetry value ΔfH° = −1732.0 ± 2.9 kJ/mol.
Mn2SiO4-Robie-1982.thermal_function: Cp = 261.28 - 0.01378*T - 2217.7/sqrt(T) J mol^-1 K^-1; integrated from 298.15 K, with the source fit extended from 1600 K to the 1616-1620 K transition interval.

MnAl2O4-open-primary.source: Navarro, Gomez, and de Avillez (2012) measured stoichiometric galaxite heat capacity from 2 to 873 K; Navarro, de Avillez, Goes, and Gomes (2020) measured its low-temperature heat capacity and reported S°298.15 = 118.7 ± 0.5 J/(mol K); Ilatovskaya and Fabrichnaya (2019) reported primary DSC heat-capacity measurements and DTA melting behavior.
MnAl2O4-open-primary.formation_enthalpy_derivation: Premise: ΔfH°(MnAl2O4) = ΔfH°(MnO) + ΔfH°(Al2O3) + ΔH°(MnO + Al2O3 → MnAl2O4). Algebra: -385.0 + (-1675.692) + (-39.5) = -2100.192. Units: kJ mol^-1 formula. Sanity: the oxide-association term is much smaller than the sum of the oxide formation enthalpies and is included with ±12.6 kJ mol^-1 once.
MnAl2O4-open-primary.thermal_function: Cp = 160.69 + 0.01444*T - 3.52381e6/T^2 J mol^-1 K^-1; the primary DSC fit covers 250-873 K and is extrapolated to the 1992-2000 K melting interval. Premise: dH/dT=Cp and dS/dT=Cp/T; integrating the fit gives H-H(298.15) in J mol^-1 and S-S(298.15) in J mol^-1 K^-1. The positive Cp and increasing H,S over the tabulated range are the sanity check.
